guard: the command socket's one parser accepts each valid mod frame and refuses each malformed one, one cell per rule
why: Each mutation loosens one parser rule, so a frame the mod must not send is read as valid.
The suite runs src/command-frames.ts under tsx, so no mutation needs a build.
M2, M3 and M15 remove a guard whose absence still throws, but a TypeError or SyntaxError rather than the parser's refusal; the cells assert the refusal itself.

mutations.expectRed: refuses a line one byte over 1 MiB
mutations.cell: refuses a line one byte over 1 MiB

mutations.expectRed: refuses a line that is not JSON
mutations.cell: refuses a line that is not JSON

mutations.name: M3 the parser reads a frame that is not an object
mutations.find: if (!isFields(frame)) refuse("the line is not a JSON object");
mutations.expectRed: refuses JSON null
mutations.cell: refuses JSON null
